correctness.rationale: Exact normalized row Fourier identity; constancy of modulus makes every nonzero Fourier autocorrelation vanish. For 2 or 3 Fourier frequencies at odd prime p≥5, a nonzero directed frequency difference occurs only once and forces contradiction. The character-row indices form a subgroup through a multiplicative ratio cocycle, hence either 1 or p of them. Summing row supports gives exactly p or at least 1+4(p-1). Telescoping character ratios proves matched-curvature chirp classification. Standalone checker executed successfully for 446 finite assertions, corroborative only. No unattained sharpness claim.
